name: TOKENMIXER_LARGE
extra_cmd: bash -c 'set -e; d="./benchmark/models/tokenmixer-large/original/amzn_books.ori"; src="../../../datasets"; if [ -L "$d" ]; then rm -f "$d"; elif [ -e "$d" ] && [ ! -d "$d" ]; then rm -f "$d"; fi; mkdir -p "$d"; if ! compgen -G "$d/*.csv" > /dev/null; then if compgen -G "$src/*.csv" > /dev/null; then cp -r "$src"/. "$d"; elif compgen -G "./benchmark/dataset/*.csv" > /dev/null; then cp ./benchmark/dataset/*.csv "$d"/; else echo "ERROR: expected $src/*.csv or ./benchmark/dataset/*.csv" >&2; exit 1; fi; fi; if ! compgen -G "$d/*.csv" > /dev/null; then echo "ERROR: no CSV files under $d" >&2; exit 1; fi'
